title: Parallel lens execution with per-lens read-only copies and two time limits
summary: The reviewer run no longer walks its lenses one at a time in a single shared workspace. Each lens now runs on a fixed thread pool bounded by a new `[review] concurrency` setting, and each lens gets its own read-only `CleanCopy` of the change so a coding agent cannot mutate the tree another lens is reading. Two new time limits bound the work: `timeout_seconds` (now 1800s, shared across a lens's attempts including its retry) and `total_timeout_seconds` (2700s, counted from the first lens start, after which running lenses are stopped and waiting lenses are recorded as could-not-run). A panic, a provider failure or a context-build failure in one lens is contained to that lens, and every lens and attempt still produces exactly one journal event naming its lens.

lanes.label: Configuration
lanes.subtitle: osf.toml [review]
lanes.summary: The `[review]` table gains `concurrency` and `total_timeout_seconds`, and both timeouts are now range-checked.

lanes.label: Review run
lanes.subtitle: crates/osf review_run
lanes.summary: The reviewer run now fans its lenses out over a thread pool, each with its own read-only copy and a shared deadline.

lanes.label: Reviewer process
lanes.subtitle: coding-agent CLI
lanes.summary: The child process is now given only the time left under both limits, and its retry shares that budget.

nodes.label: ReviewConfig
nodes.subtitle: threshold, concurrency, timeouts, cost ceiling
nodes.summary: Parsed from the repository's own `osf.toml` on the base branch. Adds `concurrency` (default 8) and `total_timeout_seconds` (default 2700), raises the per-attempt default to 1800, and refuses zero, wrong types, or values above 86400 seconds, naming the setting.

nodes.label: setup()
nodes.subtitle: builds Setup from ReviewConfig
nodes.summary: Copies the new settings into the run's `Setup`: `per_attempt`, `total`, `concurrency` and `cost_ceiling`, alongside the roster, threshold and prompt.

nodes.label: run_reviewer_with()
nodes.subtitle: one reviewer, all its lenses
nodes.summary: Creates the shared change folder once, takes the whole-run deadline, then hands the selected lenses to the pool. An idle reviewer or a failed change folder still starts no worker and records one lens record each.

nodes.label: run_pool()
nodes.subtitle: fixed worker pool over a shared queue
nodes.summary: Spawns `min(concurrency, lens count)` scoped threads that pop lens indices from a mutex-guarded queue and write results back in index order, so the journal order is stable regardless of which thread finished first.

nodes.label: run_lens()
nodes.subtitle: one lens, one read-only copy
nodes.summary: Checks the deadline, creates a read-only `CleanCopy` of the change for this lens alone, builds the lens context, renders the prompt and runs the attempts. The copy is dropped when the lens ends.

nodes.label: contain_panic()
nodes.subtitle: catch_unwind per lens
nodes.summary: Wraps a lens body so a panic becomes a could-not-run record naming the lens and the panic message, instead of unwinding the pool and losing the other lenses' results.

nodes.label: deadline_after()
nodes.subtitle: Instant::now() + total
nodes.summary: Computes the instant the whole-run limit ends, or returns an error naming `total_timeout_seconds` when the duration is too large to add to the current instant.

nodes.label: Attempts::once()
nodes.subtitle: per-attempt and total budget
nodes.summary: Gives the child `min(per_attempt, remaining until deadline)`, records a not-started attempt once the deadline has passed, and rewrites a timeout reason to name whichever limit actually bound it.

nodes.label: judge_lens()
nodes.subtitle: context errors now judged
nodes.summary: A lens with a context error now also pushes a could-not-run `Judged` record before returning the verdict, so the lens still appears in the journal with its name.

nodes.label: run_with_retry()
nodes.subtitle: sandbox check, run, retry share one budget
nodes.summary: Starts a clock, then gives the sandbox check, the first child run and the retry each only the time left under the attempt's timeout, returning could-not-run when nothing is left.

nodes.label: coding-agent CLI
nodes.subtitle: opencode / omp / claude
nodes.summary: The reviewer child process. It reads the prompt on stdin, works inside the read-only copy it is given, and writes an answer file. It is unaware of the pool and of the other lenses.

nodes.label: CleanCopy
nodes.subtitle: tracked + untracked files
nodes.summary: Gains `create_read_only`, which copies as before and then clears the write bit deepest-first: files 0o444 and folders 0o555 on Unix, the read-only attribute elsewhere. `Drop` restores write permission before removing the tree.

nodes.label: ChangeFolder
nodes.subtitle: diff and commit log on disk
nodes.summary: The one folder per reviewer run that holds the diff and commit log the prompt points at. It is created once and shared by every lens of that reviewer.

edges.label: concurrency, timeouts, ceiling
edges.summary: The validated `[review]` settings become the run's `Setup`.

edges.label: lenses, workers
edges.summary: The change the PR is really about: lenses are handed to a bounded pool instead of being run in a loop.

edges.label: Instant deadline
edges.summary: The single instant every lens and every attempt is measured against.

edges.label: create_read_only(root)
edges.summary: Each lens gets its own read-only copy, so parallel lenses cannot see or corrupt each other's tree.

edges.label: reads, cannot write
edges.summary: The agent works inside the read-only copy; a write attempt fails with permission denied.

views.title: Review run: pool, copies and limits
views.summary: The reviewer run fans its lenses out over a bounded pool. Each lens owns a read-only copy of the change and is bounded by a per-attempt limit and a whole-run deadline.

views.title: Where the two time limits come from
views.summary: The `[review]` settings are validated once, then become the per-attempt duration, the whole-run duration and the deadline every attempt is measured against.

children.title: Read-only copy lifecycle
children.summary: `create_read_only` copies the tracked and untracked files, then clears the write bit deepest-first; `Drop` restores it before removing the tree.

steps.heading: Settings are validated
steps.body: `[review]` gains concurrency and a whole-run timeout, and both timeouts are range-checked.

detail.text: `ReviewConfig` now carries `concurrency` and `total_timeout_seconds`, and `review_config` refuses zero or values above 86400 seconds.

steps.heading: Lenses fan out
steps.body: The selected lenses go to a fixed pool of `min(concurrency, lens count)` threads.

detail.text: `run_pool` pops lens indices from a shared queue and writes results back in index order, so the journal order does not depend on which thread finished first.

steps.heading: One read-only copy per lens
steps.body: Each lens creates its own read-only `CleanCopy` and drops it when the lens ends.

detail.text: `create_read_only` clears the write bit deepest-first, so the coding agent that starts in the copy cannot change it.

steps.heading: Two limits bound every attempt
steps.body: An attempt gets `min(per_attempt, remaining until deadline)`, and its retry shares that budget.

detail.text: `Attempts::once` gives the child only the time left under both limits, and `run_with_retry` gives the sandbox check, the first run and the retry that same budget.

steps.heading: One lens cannot stop the others
steps.body: A panic, a provider failure or a context error is recorded as could-not-run for that lens alone.

detail.text: `contain_panic` turns a panic into a could-not-run record, and `judge_lens` now pushes a judged record for a lens whose context failed.
